Implemented from scratch (parsing for *, ranges, steps, lists, @shortcuts, correct OR-not-AND day-of-month/day-of-week semantics, next-5-run-time computation, plain-English description generator), verified the full algorithm against 12 test vectors plus 5 error cases in Node before shipping, then re-verified interactively in a real browser (examples, live parsing, copy button, error states) via screenshots - all correct, including proper weekend-skipping for a weekdays-only schedule.
